source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Tree Topology' (PDF 11): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Tree topology mein devices darakht (tree) ki tarah hierarchical structure (oopar se neeche darja-ba-darja tarteeb) mein hote hain (jaise Figure 1.12 mein). Is mein bus aur star dono topologies ki khoobiyan hain: kai star networks ek central backbone (bari main cable) se jure hote hain. Data root (main node, jar) se branches (shaakhon) aur sub-branches (chhoti shaakhon) tak behta hai. Is se bare networks ko barhana aur manage karna aasan hai. Lekin backbone fail ho jaye to poore network par asar par sakta hai. Tree topology bari organizations (idaron) mein aam istemal hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Tree topology: khari Backbone Cable jis ke dono siron par dhakkan hain. Concentrator (hub) S1 nodes A, B aur C ko jorta hai; S2 nodes D, E aur F ko; S2 se juri teesri concentrator (hub) nodes G, H aur I ko. Server seedha backbone se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.12: Tree topology (kitab ki Figure 1.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tree topology mein concentrators (hubs) S1, S2 aur teesra hub chhote star networks banate hain: har hub ke nodes (A se I) usi se jure hain. Yeh hubs aur server ek lambi backbone cable se jure hain, is liye backbone kharab ho to poora network ruk jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Tree topology mein bus aur star ki kaun si khoobiyan milti hain?
blocks.explanation: Star: har hub ke saath devices star ki tarah jure hain. Bus: yeh hubs ek main backbone cable se jure hain.

items: Tree: hierarchical, kai star networks ek backbone par; barhana aasan; backbone kharab to poore network par asar.
